item.title: Weekly Threat Summary — 2026-11-07 — Cyber Threat Wall Weekly intelligence brief
item.description: Threat Signal —. CISA added 3 actively exploited vulnerabilities during the last 7 days. Web Applications / CMS is the most represented technology category among this week's new KEVs (1). WordPress has the most new KEV entries this week (1). CVE-2026-102764 is the largest 7-day rank riser, up 646 positions.
